Spacecraft e-st@r (e-star-i)
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Status Reentry 2015-01-16. Was operational until 2012-12-XX, communication stopped.
Launched 2012-02-13
NORAD ID 38079
Deployer P-POD (Poly-Picosatellite Orbital Deployer)
Launcher Vega
Organisation Politecnico di Torino
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Headquarters Italy
Launch brokerer ESA Education Office, Cal Poly
Oneliner

Demonstrate CubeSat platform technologies for educational purposes with focus on ADCS.
Description

Demonstrate the capability of autonomous determination, control and manoeuver, through the development and test in orbit of an ADCS entirely designed and manufactured by students. Test in orbit COTS technology and self-made hardware.
